subject: Chemistry
objectiveMappingPolicy: Official objectives are retained at topic level because the cited KIE syllabuses do not map each objective one-to-one to a numbered sub-topic.

source.authority: Kenya Institute of Education (KIE), Ministry of Education, Science and Technology
source.title: Secondary Education Syllabus Volume Two

objectives.label: a)
objectives.text: recall the topics related to chemistry taught at primary school level

objectives.label: b)
objectives.text: explain what the study of chemistry is about

objectives.label: c)
objectives.text: name and state the uses of common apparatus in the laboratory

objectives.label: d)
objectives.text: describe a Bunsen burner and its flame

objectives.label: e)
objectives.text: state laboratory safety rules.

objectives.label: a)
objectives.text: carry out simple experiments to obtain pure substances from mixtures

objectives.label: b)
objectives.text: state the criteria for identifying a pure substance

objectives.label: c)
objectives.text: define and determine the melting point and boiling point of a substance

objectives.label: d)
objectives.text: explain the three states of matter (solid, liquid, gas) in terms of a simplified form of the kinetic theory

objectives.label: e)
objectives.text: state the effect of heat on a variety of substances

objectives.label: f)
objectives.text: distinguish between permanent and non-permanent changes

objectives.label: g)
objectives.text: define an element, a compound, an atom and a molecule

objectives.label: h)
objectives.text: name and write the chemical symbols of common elements

objectives.label: i)
objectives.text: recognize the constituents of matter from given examples

objectives.label: j)
objectives.text: distinguish between mixtures and compounds

objectives.label: k)
objectives.text: apply separation techniques to extract various substances from natural sources.

objectives.label: a)
objectives.text: prepare and use plant extracts as acidbase indicators

objectives.label: b)
objectives.text: use indicators to identify acids and bases

objectives.label: c)
objectives.text: state simple properties of acids and bases

objectives.label: d)
objectives.text: name uses of acids and bases

objectives.label: e)
objectives.text: state effects of acids on substances.

subTopics.name: Simple properties of acids and bases:

objectives.label: a)
objectives.text: state the percentage composition of air by volume

objectives.label: b)
objectives.text: carry out simple experiments to show that oxygen is the active part of air

objectives.label: c)
objectives.text: determine the percentage of oxygen in air using suitable methods

objectives.label: d)
objectives.text: describe the combustion of specified elements in air and oxygen and name the products59

objectives.label: e)
objectives.text: explain how liquefied air can be separated into its components by fractional distillation

objectives.label: f)
objectives.text: carry out experiments to investigate the conditions for rusting, and state the composition of rust

objectives.label: g)
objectives.text: state methods of preventing rusting

objectives.label: h)
objectives.text: prepare oxygen, investigate its properties and state its uses

objectives.label: i)
objectives.text: arrange some elements in order of their reactivity with oxygen using experimental data

objectives.label: j)
objectives.text: classify the products of burning elements in oxygen either as acidic or basic

objectives.label: k)
objectives.text: state pollution effects due to burning of substances in air

objectives.label: l)
objectives.text: state the uses of reactivity series.

subTopics.name: Application Extraction of metals (use the concept of reactivity series only)

objectives.label: a)
objectives.text: state sources of water

objectives.label: b)
objectives.text: describe an experiment to show water is a product of burning organic matter

objectives.label: c)
objectives.text: describe an experiment to show that water contains hydrogen

objectives.label: d)
objectives.text: state the products of reactions of cold water and steam with different metals

objectives.label: e)
objectives.text: list the order of reactivity of metals as obtained from metal-water reactions

objectives.label: f)
objectives.text: prepare hydrogen, investigate its properties and state its uses.

objectives.label: g)
objectives.text: define oxidation as oxygen gain and reduction as removal of oxygen

objectives.label: h)
objectives.text: explain metal oxide reactions with hydrogen in terms of reduction and oxidation.60
